note: A2 in data/suite_classification.json means 'buildable and verifiable', NOT 'advised'. These nine tasks were classified A2 by keyword; this file records the engineering verdict after investigation.

712.name: Raft for coordination
712.trigger: ledger must survive host loss or have more than one writer
712.why: majority 2 of 3 is achievable; crash-fault model matches the deployment

713.name: Paxos for agreement
713.why: Raft covers the same ground with fewer ways to be subtly wrong; building both is duplicate work

714.name: complete consensus suite
714.why: umbrella task; the audit document is its index

715.name: HotStuff
715.why: needs >=7 replicas for f=2 plus threshold signatures; no BLS/ed25519 crate exists and n=3 gives f=0

716.name: asynchronous consensus
716.why: safety under asynchrony requires 3f+1 replicas and reliable broadcast; f=0 here so the property cannot be exercised

717.name: randomized consensus
717.why: a termination mechanism for an async BFT protocol that does not exist

718.name: complete consensus testing
718.why: harness over the real decision path (partition 3 peers, kill the kernel mid-proposal) is the only thing that makes the current claim checkable

719.name: consensus optimization
719.why: nothing real to optimise; optimising a vote counter is meaningless

571.name: forward chaining inference
571.why: no inference engine; only shield_rules::describe() (fixed decision order). Cheapest real engine: shard facts + shield-shaped rules in Kleene K3, checkable against the corpus

572.name: backward chaining inference
572.why: no goal-directed search; no prover binary (z3/cvc5/vampire/eprover absent); TPTP MPTP2078 28,346 problems sit unused by any Rust code

573.name: case-based reasoning
573.why: no case base or adaptation; fabric gives similarity retrieval only

574.name: analogical reasoning
574.why: no structure-mapping; every 'analog' hit is prose or an analogue signal

575.name: abductive reasoning
575.why: zero hits for abduct; no hypothesis space or cost model

576.name: default reasoning
576.why: no defeasible/non-monotonic code; K3 UNKNOWN is a truth value, not a default rule. Exceptions become a rule class once 571 exists

577.name: temporal reasoning
577.why: time is wall-clock stamps only; no interval or LTL calculus, and no caller for one

578.name: spatial reasoning
578.why: zero Rust hits; no spatial or geometric data on this host

579.name: complete reasoning suite
579.why: umbrella over 571-578; eight of nine absent

580.name: explainable reasoning reports
580.why: votes carry reason + [axis: A#]; cards carry reason; cadence cites samples >= 200; /council/axioms and /k3/rules publish the framework. Missing: a derivation trace and any endpoint reconstructing an argument

measured_defects: commit() accepts at COMMIT_THRESHOLD without consulting prepare_votes (test: commit_without_any_prepare_vote_is_accepted)
two conflicting proposals are both accepted (test: two_conflicting_proposals_are_both_accepted)
a reject vote is silently dropped; 14 rejections still accepted (test: disagreement_cannot_prevent_acceptance)
council server has no PBFT phases at all; decisions are a weighted tally with seeded static proposals
companion bridge ships f=33 / 67-of-100 quorum / TMR 1e-18 claims with no mechanism
federation declares threshold 4 of 5 against 3 configured peers
